evals.name: start

evals.expected_output: Scaffolds window + triangle (or chunk data) with TODOs; no full engine; Mentions OpenGL/WebGL setup and chunked block storage

assertions.text: Routes correctly: reads the build-your-own-x router SKILL.md and the 'voxel-engine' track skill before answering
